activity.role: Singer and performer recording I Will Always Love You for The Bodyguard
activity.notes: The recording of I Will Always Love You was issued November 3, 1992, included on The Bodyguard soundtrack. Whitney Houston performed the song; it was WRITTEN by Dolly Parton, so authorship must NOT be misattributed to Houston. 1992 is a major specific performance milestone, not one-year entire recording career.
